# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
The adapter targets NextItNet: causal dilated convolutional residual blocks with positionwise normalization and explicit padding masks. Structure inspection also recognizes an optional cumulative-prefix depth gate. The model implementation is not supplied, so architecture claims depend on inspection and empirical checks.

`view.log2feats(sequence)` produces B × L × D features. Final sequence representations use the **largest nonpadding index**, correctly handling left-padded histories. `view.predict_score(features, items)` supplies item scores; `view.item_emb.weight` supplies item vectors.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the actual network through `view.model`, mapped training histories through `view.user_train`, and optional metadata through the view. `run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` reads up to ten `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` batches. It evaluates without gradients and restores module modes and Python, NumPy, Torch and CUDA RNG states afterward.

# Probes & Metrics
- **Training separation:** Positive-minus-negative margins, tenth percentile, negative-win rate, margins below 0.5 and tie-adjusted pairwise accuracy. Stronger separation is favorable on sampled training pairs; margins depend on score scale.
- **Representation geometry:** Item and endpoint norms, covariance spectra, leading variance share and entropy effective rank, before and after normalization. Concentration flags limited variation without establishing ranking quality. Angular alignment near 0.5 means approximately zero mean cosine.
- **Candidate-depth audit:** Up to 200 users’ final training interactions become targets. Ten nested samples of 99/499/999 unseen negatives measure rank, HR@10 and tenth-negative margins. Up to 50 users receive exact eligible-pool ranks and hypergeometric sampling calibration. Coverage and recommendation frequency describe restricted-pool outputs.

# Perturbation & Tests
Checks cover repeatability, batch ordering, future-token causality, reachable convolution offsets and removal of leading padding. Endpoint probes delete old or recent tokens and measure fixed-pair margin changes.

Identified-user probes delete, zero, frequency-match-replace or shuffle history regions at 25%/50% strengths. Fixed 99-item candidates isolate absolute and signed score changes. Geometry controls, eligibility counts and paired bootstrap intervals support cautious interpretation; sensitivity alone has no universally good direction.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
The result contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, including structure, checks, representation statistics, training separation, interventions, sensitivity and candidate-depth records, exclusions, strata, uncertainty and runtime.

These are exploratory training-data diagnostics. They cannot establish held-out performance, causality, intent or simulator traits. Missing evidence is explicitly unavailable. Four-category macro results require external aggregation. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` requests an evidence-grounded JSON interpretation with status, findings, implications and headline metrics.
